notes: *but that* is taken as one rendering of the waw of וְהָיוּ under rule 55's contiguous coordinator-plus-subordinator clause, headed on *but*; the competing reading heads on *that*.
Both resultative לְ's are unrepresented once הָיָה carries *may be* (rule 21), and the dative לִי/לָהֶם prepositions are unrepresented with their suffixes taking the bare possessives (rule 40).
